desc:

If you live and breathe NVIDIA-centric hardware design and have shipped control-oriented boards before, I’m ready to get started.

title: Portable 4G SIM Bonding Device
desc:

Scope of work  
• Hardware: board design, enclosure, integrated high-gain antenna, SIM tray/slots (minimum 4), battery and power-management circuitry.  
• Firmware: real-time link aggregation logic, automatic cell reselection, fail-over, IPSec client with configurable policies, and a simple captive portal or serial console for first-time setup.  
• Management software: web UI plus optional CLI/REST API to show bonded throughput, per-SIM stats, signal strength and VPN status, with secure remote firmware-upgrade capability.  
• Documentation: schematics, BOM, mechanical drawings, firmware source, build instructions, and a quick-start guide.  
• Validation: lab tests demonstrating bonded bandwidth, seamless hand-over between SIMs, and a stable IPSec tunnel during mobility. Packet-loss, latency and throughput logs must accompany the final report.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Device boots in under 40 s and automatically brings up an IPSec tunnel.  
2. At least 100 Mbps aggregated downlink achievable under ideal radio conditions.  
3. VPN reconnection in <5 s after any single SIM drop.  
4. Complete documentation and source deliverables provided.

title: Passport OCR to Excel Tool
desc:
I regularly receive Indian passport copies in both PDF and high-resolution image formats and I’m looking to automate the data entry. Your job is to deliver a small, dependable tool that pulls the key fields from each file—Name, Date of Birth, Passport Number, Issue Date, Expiry Date, Place of Birth, Nationality and Gender—and drops them into a single, neatly structured Excel sheet.

The workflow I’m after is straightforward:

1. Drag-and-drop or batch-select PDFs and images.
2. The tool runs OCR, interprets the standard Indian passport layout, and writes each record as a new row in one master sheet.
3. A quick accuracy log or on-screen preview lets me spot-check results before I save.

Python, Tesseract, OpenCV or any reliable OCR/ML library are fine; the final choice is yours as long as it runs on Windows without complex setup. Packaged executable (or a clean virtual-env project) plus clear, step-by-step instructions are all I need to start using it the same day.

Acceptance will be based on:
• Correct extraction of every required field from at least 30 sample passports of mixed quality.
• Output matching the column order mentioned above with no manual tweaks.
• Processing time that feels reasonable for office use (a few seconds per file is perfect).

Hand over the code, compiled build (if applicable), and a short read-me documenting dependencies and usage. Once it checks out, I’ll close the project immediately and leave feedback.

title: Outdoor RFID Reader Development
desc:
I need a custom-built RFID reader that can reliably pick up standard identification tags in an outdoor setting. The enclosure must withstand sun, rain, and an occasional hose-down while still offering stable read range and low error rates.

At this stage I am open about the operating band—LF, HF, or UHF—so long as we can balance range, power consumption, and tag cost. I expect us to discuss the trade-offs early and lock the decision in before PCB layout begins.

Here is how I see the work flowing:

• Electronic design—from antenna matching through to the microcontroller or SoC that will parse tag IDs and forward them over a simple UART, USB, or Ethernet interface.  
• Firmware—clean, documented C/C++ code (Arduino, ESP-IDF, or a bare-metal toolchain is fine) that wakes the reader, captures the tag UID, applies basic error checking, and pushes the data upstream.  
• Weather-resistant enclosure—3D model plus STL/STEP files suitable for injection moulding or rugged 3-D printing.  
• Prototype build and functional test—photos, short video, and log files proving outdoor reads of at least 95 % success over 500 cycles.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Reader consistently detects ISO-compliant identification tags at the agreed range.  
2. Operates for 72 h on continuous duty in 0 °C-40 °C with no memory leaks or resets.  
3. Complete deliverables: schematic, BOM, Gerbers, firmware source, enclosure CAD, and a concise user guide.

title: Social Media Brand Awareness Content
desc:
I am expanding our online presence and need a hands-on partner to plan, create, and distribute content that boosts brand awareness. The focus is squarely on Facebook and Instagram, so every deliverable should be tailored for those feeds, Stories, and Reels.

I’m looking for compelling short-form videos and eye-catching infographics that tell our story quickly and memorably. You’ll start by mapping out a simple content calendar, then move straight into production: scripting or storyboarding, design, editing, and finally scheduling posts with engaging captions and hashtags. Consistent visual branding, clear calls to action that spark follows and shares, and data-driven tweaks after each post are essential.

Please share recent Facebook or Instagram work that highlights your video and infographic skills, outline the tools you rely on (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Canva, etc.), and give me a brief view of your workflow from concept to published post.

title: AI Animated Kids Story Series -- 2
desc:
I’m building a “Learn & Fun” story series for children on YouTube and need a creative partner who can drive the entire video side with the help of AI-powered tools.  

The goal is to publish a sequence of short, colourful episodes—around 3-5 minutes each—that weave simple educational concepts into entertaining adventures. Think bright, friendly characters, clear narration, lively music, and on-screen text or graphics that reinforce what the kids are learning without ever feeling like a lesson.  

Here’s how I picture our workflow:  
• I supply the story outline and key learning points for each episode.  
• You turn that into a finished video—scripting, visual generation (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar), voice-over with AI or a real voice, basic sound design, and final editing in Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci, or the tool you’re most efficient with.  
• We iterate quickly on the first pilot; once approved we roll into the rest of the series with a consistent look and pace.  

Acceptance criteria for each episode  
1. 3-5 min runtime, 1080p minimum, ready for YouTube upload.  
2. Clear hook in the first 20 seconds and a gentle call-to-action at the end.  
3. Visuals, narration, captions, and background music fully synced and child-safe.  
4. All source assets (project files, images, audio) delivered so I can localise later.  

If you love crafting stories for kids and enjoy experimenting with AI video workflows, let’s talk and create something magical together.

title: Faceless Niche News Video Editing
desc:
I run a YouTube channel that delivers tightly-edited, narrator-free news updates on niche topics—think breaking stories in tech, sports, and other fast-moving verticals. I’m looking for a long-term collaborator who can turn scripts (or curated headlines I provide) into polished, ready-to-publish videos that never show a presenter on camera.

Here’s what I need from you, starting ASAP: 

• Source or create engaging b-roll, motion graphics, screenshots, and short licensed clips that illustrate each story.  
• Generate a clear, natural-sounding AI voice-over (English) that matches the script timing.  
• Synchronise visuals, voice, captions, lower thirds, and subtle background music so the pace feels energetic yet easy to follow.  
• Deliver final files in 1080p (or higher), optimized for YouTube SEO—thumbnail stills, metadata suggestions, and chapter timestamps included.  
• Turnaround: ideally within 24–48 hours per video so the channel stays timely.  

Acceptance criteria  
1. Video length aligns with the brief (usually 6–10 minutes).  
2. Audio is balanced, free of artefacts, and cleared for monetisation.  
3. All footage and music are copyright-safe (Creative Commons, stock licences, or original work).  
4. No on-screen host faces; the style must remain fully “faceless.”
